goal: The mc proposals left open after the triage of 2026-09-18 are built: every verb answers --help, the plan door judges a pull request against the plan its branch started from, a landed branch whose merge conflicts is read as landed, the quota pause lasts until the reset the refusal names, a session has a scratch directory outside its worktree, a hung process after a result is not a stalled step, mc status reads a killed merge the way the runner does, the brief gathers no document, and the documentation no longer describes the repair session.

success_criteria.criterion: Every verb the dispatcher routes answers --help with its usage on stdout and exit 0.
success_criteria.check: `for v in status work repo merge test dev deploy worker brief helper plan run roles log step; do mc $v --help >/dev/null || echo $v; done` prints nothing; `mc test dev --help` exits 0.

success_criteria.criterion: A plan edit that lands on main while a step runs is not attributed to the step's pull request.
success_criteria.check: The new case in tests/mc/merge-boundary.test.js: base moved steps[3] after the merge base, head edits only its own step — `ok: true`.

success_criteria.criterion: A quota refusal that names its reset holds every lane until then.
success_criteria.check: The new test in tests/mc/run.test.js: a result text `resets Sep 11 at 3pm (Europe/Stockholm)` makes the lanes sleep until 2026-09-11T13:01:00Z in slices, and starts no session before it.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc brief` opens the session with no gathered document, and `--collect` is an unknown flag.
success_criteria.check: `mc brief --collect` exits 2; `grep -rn "renderBrief\|collectBrief" src` is empty; `npm test` is green.

success_criteria.criterion: No document or comment describes a repair session, `held.json` or `stalled,open` as something mc does.
success_criteria.check: `grep -rniE "repair session|a repair on|stalled,open" docs/technical docs/project/README.md src/mc` finds only dated history sentences.

steps.title: --help on every verb
steps.done_when: `mc <verb> --help` and `mc <verb> -h` print that verb's usage on stdout and exit 0 for every verb in `routeV1Command`'s table, and tests/mc/help.test.js walks the table to prove it.

steps.title: The plan door compares against the merge base
steps.done_when: `planBoundary` reads its `before` plan from `git merge-base origin/<base> origin/<head>` and falls back to `origin/<base>` only when that cannot be read, with a test for a plan edit that landed on main after the branch started.

steps.title: A landed branch whose merge conflicts reads landed
steps.done_when: `branchLanded` answers `landed` for a branch with no commit after its merged pull request even when `git merge-tree` conflicts, and `freshBranch` moves such a workarea to `<name>-<n>`.

steps.title: The quota pause lasts until the reset the refusal names
steps.done_when: A quota answer whose text carries `resets …` holds every lane until one minute after that time, in slices that end on STOP or UPDATE; one without a readable time keeps the thirty minutes.

steps.title: A scratch directory per run
steps.done_when: Every step session is started with `MC_SCRATCH` naming an existing directory `~/mc/runner/scratch/<project>-<stamp>/`, `canon/roles/_common.md` tells a session to put probes there, and the chore pass removes scratch directories older than seven days.

steps.title: A process that hangs after its result is not a stalled step
steps.done_when: Once `streamSession` has seen the `result` line, the process gets `RESULT_GRACE_MS` (two minutes) to exit and is then killed with the result standing: status 0, `stalled: false`, and the `runs.tsv` note is the session's own word.

steps.title: mc status reads a killed merge the way the runner does
steps.done_when: `machineState` answers runnable for a worktree whose only dirt is a merge of origin/main left in progress, keeps `dirty` when there is other work beside it, and the `RUN_REFUSALS` agreement table has both cases.

steps.title: The documentation no longer describes the repair session
steps.done_when: No sentence in docs/technical, docs/project/README.md or a comment in src/mc describes a repair session, a repair kind, `held.json` or a merge lane as something mc does today, and `checkInPrompt` has no `repair` branch.

steps.title: The brief gathers no document
steps.done_when: `mc brief` opens or resumes the brief session with the role and no gathered document; `--collect`, `--offline`, `collectBrief`, `renderBrief` and everything only they used are gone; `canon/roles/brief.md` tells the session where the ground is read.
